evidence.note: Orientation phase (inspect workspace/data/tokenizer, read template) precedes any training — deliberate first milestone before acting.
First run is an ITERATIONS=1, 300s smoke test rather than a big training push — a working end-to-end pipeline is validated before scaling.
Repeated ITERATIONS=1 runs sweeping MODEL_DIM/MLP_HIDDEN/NUM_LAYERS — config sizing probes gate the choice before committing full compute.
Only after smoke/sizing does a full training run start (57), followed by resumed INIT_CKPT tuning runs — a distinct 'improve' phase after baseline.
Load/quantize checks and du -b size verification against the 32MB cap happen at the END, not locked before scaling — behavioral gates exist but sequenced late, without stated per-phase criteria.

reasoning: The action arc shows a genuine baseline-first decomposition — orientation, a 1-iteration end-to-end smoke test, config-sizing sweeps, then full training, tuning, and final size/load verification — clearly above implicit ordering (3) and matching the 'clear phases with small model first, then improve' anchor (5). It edges toward 8 because concrete gates (size via du -b, load/compile checks, config sizing for the byte budget) are present, but the grader-interface/size correctness verification lands at the end rather than being locked before capacity scaling, and no explicit per-milestone done-criteria are stated, so it settles at 6.
